AnswerCheck.description:
The validator's verdict on one answer attempt: accepted, or sent back with readable
reasons (the model then rewrites it). `repairs` counts fact-free fixes applied first.
AnswerCheck.title: AnswerCheck

AnswerDraft.description:
Provisional summary text while the model writes its answer. Not checked yet: the client
shows it as a draft and replaces it with the validated `text.delta` stream.
AnswerDraft.title: AnswerDraft

AssumeFact.description: Imagine one recorded fact on a path, e.g. width_m = 1.2.
AssumeFact.title: AssumeFact

BuildRamp.description: Imagine a capital work: the path rebuilt step-free (steps become a ramp).
BuildRamp.title: BuildRamp

BuildingsLayer.description: OSM building footprints and trees for the stylised 3D city (display only).
BuildingsLayer.title: BuildingsLayer

ChatEventDoc.description: Wrapper used only so that OpenAPI exports the ChatEvent union for the TS client.
ChatEventDoc.title: ChatEventDoc

ClosePath.description: Imagine a path closed (works, an event, a fallen tree).
ClosePath.title: ClosePath

ClosureOut.description: A closure as the public sees it: always a staff report, never a verified fact.
ClosureOut.title: ClosureOut

EvacuationReport.description: Journeys from a seeded sample of origins to the nearest reachable evacuation centre.
EvacuationReport.title: EvacuationReport

note.default: Sampled journeys on the township model; a planning estimate, not a promise. Residents never see these numbers.
note.title: Note

GapProperties.description: Per element: how many facts are not yet checked for the profile, and why it matters.
GapProperties.title: GapProperties

ProfileInfo.description: Read-only profile parameters, for the 'Assumptions' section. No secrets, no per-user data.
ProfileInfo.title: ProfileInfo

disclaimer.default: Synthetic residents on the township model: an indicative simulation, not a forecast. River stages are scenarios, not water depths; departure times, warnings and crowding are not modelled; animation speed is illustrative. Follow official MBSA / JPS / NADMA guidance.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

SetRiverStage.description: River rise scenario (indicative stages only; a stage never upgrades anything).
SetRiverStage.title: SetRiverStage

SimAdvisory.title: SimAdvisory

SimRun.description:
A run's state. `report` is set only when `status` is `done`. `cancelled` (staff asked) and
`timeout` (the total time budget ran out) end a run without a report.
SimRun.title: SimRun

VRRow.description: A VR plus the claim's current value, so staff see what Verify would confirm.
VRRow.title: VRRow

disclaimer.default: Survey plan from the township model: journeys would be confirmed only if they pass when staff check these facts on site. A planning estimate, not a promise.
disclaimer.title: Disclaimer

VerifyFact.description: Imagine staff verifying a fact: it passes every profile's limit, or it fails.
VerifyFact.title: VerifyFact

get.description:
The planner's belief over unchecked facts: Beta(alpha, beta) per path type and attribute,
from regional OSM tags (if built) and real staff verifications. Planning only.

Staff-reported closures. active=true (default): in force now; active=false: ended or not
started yet. Every row is a staff report, labelled as such. `note` is shown to staff only.

post.description:
Staff-only JPEG/PNG upload (max 5 MB). Type is decided by magic bytes; metadata (EXIF,
GPS, comments, text chunks) is stripped before anything is stored.

get.description: Liveness that includes the world: a corrupt seed fails here, not only on every request.

OSM buildings and trees. Declared before /layers/{lens} so it wins. 404 when the world has
no base/buildings.geojson (the client then falls back to the plain scene).

404.description: no buildings seed for this world

get.description:
Gap map: per walk edge and place, how many relevant facts are not yet checked, how many
are stale or only reported, open verification demand and simulated journey impact. Declared
before /layers/{lens} so it wins.

Synthetic residents per persona heading for the nearest evacuation centre at every river
stage, with routes for the 3D animation. Indicative simulation, not a forecast. Cached by
world version (the first call on the seed takes about 15 s).

503.description: the township model is busy; retry shortly

post.description: Plan only: this anonymous endpoint never files verification requests (the chat does).

schema.title: Response Scenario Water Scenarios  Scenario Id  Get

get.description: Documentation-only endpoint so OpenAPI exports the ChatEvent union.

post.description:
Start a run in the background and return its id; poll `GET /simulations/{run_id}`.

One run at a time per world: a second POST while one is queued or running gets 409 with the
running id, so the caller can poll that run instead.

409.description: a run is already in progress

post.description:
Stop a queued or running run. It ends as `cancelled` at once (the worker stops at its next
journey) and the run slot is free again. 404 unknown run, 409 if it already ended.

get.description: status=all returns every status. A resolved row's `resolution` omits the staff `note`.

post.description: Staff-filed VR; deduped against the open one (demand + 1). Same PDPA sanitising as chat.

get.description:
What this check would change (open) or changed (resolved) on the township model: sampled
journeys, the ticket's own journey and the belief. Staff planning estimate; counts only.
Survey plan: which facts to check first so the most sample journeys would be confirmed.

post.description: Imagine changes on a copy of the township and compare journeys before and after.

get.description: Engine-proposed what-if actions with readable labels (ramps, verifications, keystones).
